span.label: how to recover the firing times of individual neurons from the raw voltage recorded by a dense electrode array - the step that manufactures the single unit
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether a practical system can sort high-channel-count data at error rates comparable to tetrode methods, in human and computer time a working lab will accept
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a three-stage pipeline (masked detection, masked EM clustering, guided manual curation) reaching about 5% error, plus a measurement of how much of the result depends on which human curates it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: noise on many uninformative channels swamps signal on few informative channels, so Gaussian-mixture clustering breaks down as dimensionality grows
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: probabilistically disenfranchising low-mask channels removes their contribution to cluster assignment and so prevents threshold-crossing artefacts from generating spurious clusters
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: requiring a strong-threshold crossing inside each weak-threshold connected component discards isolated noise islands while merging weakly connected regions of one spike
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: cost scales with unmasked channels per spike rather than total channels, which is why the method stays tractable as arrays grow
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: overlapping spikes are separated not by their features, which are nearly identical, but by which channels they appear on - the mask vector
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the curse of dimensionality: on a large array the noise on uninformative channels outweighs the signal on the few informative ones
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: masked EM disenfranchises low-mask channels probabilistically, so no false cluster is created when an amplitude happens to cross a threshold
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: two thresholds rather than one: the weak one prevents a spike being split by noise, the strong one prevents noise being kept as a spike
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the human cost of curation is quadratic in clusters unless the software orders the candidate merges, which makes it linear
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: complexity scales with unmasked channels per spike, a quantity that does not grow as arrays get bigger
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Clustering can still take hours or days on large datasets with a single-core machine.
span.note: what this limits: the practical claim of usability at scale, not the accuracy results: IT CAN TAKE HOURS OR EVEN DAYS TO COMPLETE ON A STANDARD SINGLE-CORE MACHINE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Spikes that overlap in both space and time cannot be resolved by the detection algorithm.
span.note: what this limits: every spike count and every unit derived from dense-array data: IT CANNOT RESOLVE SPIKES THAT OVERLAP IN BOTH SPACE AND TIME - those spikes are absent from the output
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Operators' judgements of which clusters count as well-isolated units are subjective, so the pipeline still depends on a non-reproducible human step.
span.note: what this limits: any claim that a set of well-isolated single units is operator-independent: Quotation withheld
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: spikes that overlap in both space and time cannot be resolved at all
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 1 - spatiotemporally overlapping spikes are unresolved
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ground truth is simulated, and rests on the assumption that the extracellular medium is a linear conductor so waveforms can simply be added
span.note: what this limits: the accuracy figures only, which are measured against this truth set: WE CREATED A SIMULATED GROUND TRUTH DATASET ... SINCE THE EXTRACELLULAR MEDIUM IS A LINEAR CONDUCTOR - the validation assumes linearity
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the bursting interspike intervals that make real spike trains hard were deliberately not simulated
span.note: what this limits: the generalisation of those accuracy figures to real bursting cells: THE INTERSPIKE INTERVALS TYPICAL OF BURSTING NEURONS WERE NOT SIMULATED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: which clusters count as well-isolated single units is not reproducible between operators
span.note: what this limits: the reproducibility of the unit yield between labs: THE JUDGEMENT OF WHETHER A CLUSTER SHOULD BE CONSIDERED A WELL-ISOLATED SINGLE UNIT was not consistent across operators
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the waveform changes that force manual correction have resisted mathematical modelling
span.note: what this limits: any expectation that manual curation can be removed: WAVEFORMS ARE NOT CONSTANT, BUT CHANGE ACCORDING TO FIRING - the errors forcing manual correction resist modelling
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: runtime can reach hours or days on a single core
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - runtime, not accuracy
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: template matching, which would solve the overlap problem, is blocked less by the algorithm than by what it would do to the curation step
span.note: what this limits: the prospect of solving the overlap problem by template matching: SUCH METHODS ARE NOT AT PRESENT WIDELY APPLIED TO IN VIVO RECORDINGS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critiques → the practice of deciding by eye which units are well isolated
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHO OR WHAT DECIDES ISOLATION QUALITY. 'experienced operators tended to make similar judgements during the manual curation process, but Quotation withheld ... we therefore recommend that these [quantitative criteria] be used, RATHER THAN HUMAN JUDGEMENTS.' Note the shape: agreement between operators is granted and is not treated as evidence of correctness - concordance and validity are separated explicitly. Q-448.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: distinguishes-from → template-matching sorters validated on in vitro retinal arrays
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS THE NOISE LEVEL OF THE DATA THE METHOD WAS VALIDATED ON. 'TEMPLATE-MATCHING ALGORITHMS HAVE SOLVED THIS PROBLEM IN THE CASE OF IN VITRO RETINAL ARRAY DATA, BUT THESE DATA ARE MUCH LESS NOISY THAN IN VIVO BRAIN RECORDINGS.' The method is granted its success and the success is bounded by the preparation it was demonstrated on - so `solved` is true of one regime and unproven in the other, and a citation carries only the word. Q-500.

span.label: RETRACTED (RE-GROUNDED) · mask vector —distinct-from→ feature vector
span.note: RETRACTED: RE-GROUNDED. The old span defined the mask vector without naming the feature vector. This sentence names both, states the contrast with its direction, AND NAMES THE RESPECT IT HOLDS IN: 'although the FEATURE VECTORS of our two example spikes were VERY SIMILAR, their MASK VECTORS are COMPLETELY DIFFERENT'. Same in one representation, different in the other - which is the scoped comparison the schema has no field for, stated in a single clause. — strength of the relation: 1 — CRITERION, stated: two overlapping spikes have nearly identical feature vectors and completely different mask vectors
